journey.name: Launch and sync
journey.description: Cold-launches the app and verifies the Node screen renders with live sync, peer, and network information.

actions.action: Launch the Mandacaru app and wait for the splash screen to dismiss (poll until nav_node is present)
Verify the Node navigation item (nav_node) is selected
Verify a sync progress percentage (node_sync_percentage) is displayed
Verify the number of peers (node_peer_count) is displayed
Verify the network name (node_network) is displayed

Verify the RPC cookie exists (`adb shell run-as com.github.jvsena42.mandacaru ls files/.cookie`) and an authenticated getblockchaininfo succeeds (README recipe), while an unauthenticated one returns HTTP 401

Verify the app's own RPC calls succeed: within 30 seconds of launch `adb logcat -d -s FlorestaRpcImpl` shows "Response (getblockchaininfo)" lines, and no "RPC request error" lines appear after the first successful response (one or two before the node is up are expected)
